title: C4OS Grill Question 043 - Chat Debug Redaction And History

questions.label: Should Chat Debug ever be enabled by default?
questions.help: Recommended: disabled by default everywhere. Developers can enable it, but it should not surprise normal users.
options: Enabled by default only in development builds
Enabled by default for local projects

questions.label: Which Chat Debug values must always be redacted?
questions.help: Recommended: redact secrets, tokens, raw credential values, provider keys, auth headers, cookies, and configured sensitive parameters before display or export.
options: Secrets, tokens, raw credentials, provider keys, auth headers, cookies, and sensitive params
Only provider keys and raw credentials
Only values marked secret by the plugin/tool

questions.label: Should Chat Debug show historical runs?
questions.help: Recommended: show current and historical runs for the active chat session because debug value comes from reviewing previous tool events.
options: Current and historical runs for the active chat session
Historical runs only after explicit load

questions.label: Should users be able to export Chat Debug logs?
questions.help: Recommended: allow explicit redacted export only, never raw unredacted export.

questions.label: Where should approval decisions appear?
questions.help: Recommended: approval decisions appear in both the normal thread context and Chat Debug, with Chat Debug showing structured parameters after redaction.
options: Both thread context and Chat Debug

questions.label: Notes or corrections
questions.help: Clarify export format, retention, whether redacted values can be revealed by user action, or sensitive parameter naming rules.
